mapper.select: SELECT D.doc_id, D.doc_type, D.title, D.status, D.initiator_id, D.draft_date, D.json_content, D.updated_at, U.id AS initiator_id, U.name AS initiator_name, U.department AS initiator_department, U.rank_name AS initiator_rank FROM DOCUMENTS D JOIN USERS U ON D.INITIATOR_ID = U.ID WHERE doc_id= #{docId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO DOCUMENTS ( DOC_TYPE, TITLE, STATUS, DRAFT_DATE, JSON_CONTENT, UPDATED_AT, INITIATOR_ID ) VALUES ( #{docType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{title, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{jsonContent, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}, NOW(), #{initiatorId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE DOCUMENTS SET STATUS= 'RECALLED', UPDATED_AT= NOW() WHERE DOC_ID= #{docId} AND INITIATOR_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM APPROVAL_HISTORY WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND ACTION = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT, U_INITIATOR.NAME AS INITIATOR_NAME, U_INITIATOR.DEPARTMENT AS INITIATOR_DEPARTMENT FROM DOCUMENTS D JOIN APPROVAL_HISTORY AH ON D.DOC_ID = AH.DOC_ID JOIN USERS U_INITIATOR ON D.INITIATOR_ID = U_INITIATOR.ID WHERE AH.APPROVER_ID = #{approverId} AND AH.ACTION = 'PENDING' ORDER BY D.DRAFT_DATE DESC

SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT, /* 기안자 정보 JOIN (필요할 경우) */ U.NAME AS INITIATOR_NAME, U.DEPARTMENT AS INITIATOR_DEPARTMENT FROM DOCUMENTS D LEFT JOIN USERS U ON D.INITIATOR_ID = U.ID WHERE D.INITIATOR_ID = #{initiatorId} AND D.STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'RECALLED') ORDER BY D.UPDATED_AT DESC

SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT FROM DOCUMENTS D WHERE D.INITIATOR_ID = #{initiatorId} AND D.STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY D.DRAFT_DATE DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE DOCUMENTS SET TITLE = #{title}, JSON_CONTENT = #{jsonContent}, STATUS = 'PENDING', UPDATED_AT = NOW() WHERE DOC_ID = #{docId} AND STATUS IN ('REJECTED', 'RECALLED')
mapper.select: SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT, U.NAME AS INITIATOR_NAME, U.DEPARTMENT AS INITIATOR_DEPARTMENT FROM DOCUMENTS D LEFT JOIN USERS U ON D.INITIATOR_ID = U.ID WHERE D.DOC_ID = #{docId}

SELECT D.DOC_ID, D.DOC_TYPE, D.TITLE, D.STATUS, D.INITIATOR_ID, D.DRAFT_DATE, D.JSON_CONTENT, D.UPDATED_AT FROM DOCUMENTS D WHERE D.INITIATOR_ID = #{initiatorId} AND D.STATUS= 'APPROVED' ORDER BY D.DRAFT_DATE DESC
